blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A fire in a residential area in Sta. Mesa, Manila, on Saturday, killed one man and left more than two families homeless. The fire began on the second floor of a residential area at Road 13, NDC Compound, in Barangay 628, according to reports. The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) confirmed one casualty, a 36-year-old male whose body was discovered after the fire was put out.
